subject: Can I simulate data with factor loadings only?

messages.author: 6a75f6f91a59c568
messages.subject: Can I simulate data with factor loadings only?
parts:
Hi all,

Can I simulate data with factor loadings only?

In the current, simdata() does not care about the 'd1 parameter' is NA, but I can not have confidence that is safe.

Best,
Seongho

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Can I simulate data with factor loadings only?
parts:
No, you need to have intercept terms in IRT models. While in factor analysis models with continuous data this is generally irrelevant, estimation of categorical models need some type of threshold parameter to control the observed proportions. 

Phil
